lemmas.primary_translation: give a name to something or someone / name something or someone after someone / hail or call by radio

definitions.text: gi navn eller noe eller noen
definitions.translation: give a name to something or someone
name something or someone after someone

examples.no: de vil gjerne kalle opp bestemoren når de får barn
examples.en: they would like to name a child after the grandmother when they have children

examples.no: skolen er kalt opp etter forfatteren
examples.en: the school is named after the author

examples.no: trafikksentralen prøvde å kalle opp skipet
examples.en: the traffic control center tried to call the ship

examples.no: de ble kalt opp over radio
examples.en: they were called over the radio
